elements.label: EXAMPLE 9.7
elements.title: Example 9.7
elements.details: Text example describing how to use Python's binom function to graph binomial distributions for n=20 and p values 0.10, 0.50, and 0.85.
elements.summary: This example explains how to graph binomial distributions using Python's scipy.stats binom function for different probabilities of success, illustrating the effect of p on the distribution shape.
